titleEn: How private schools segregate students by class and strengthen social divisions
titleZh: 私立学校如何按阶层分隔学生，并强化社会分化
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: If you want to see how private schools in the UK can reinforce segregation between children of different social classes, the London Borough of Southwark provides a good example.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想看看英国的私立学校是如何加强不同社会阶层儿童之间的隔离的，伦敦萨瑟克自治市就提供了一个很好的例子。

paragraphs.en: It has three large private secondary schools, less than in other wealthier London boroughs. When we took a close look at these schools, we found that 75% of the students are from the top two social classes: from families with higher professional and managerial backgrounds.
paragraphs.zh: 它有三所大型私立中学，比其他富裕的伦敦行政区要少。当我们仔细观察这些学校时，我们发现75%的学生来自最高的两个社会阶层：来自具有更高专业和管理背景的家庭。

paragraphs.en: By contrast, in two of the 13 state schools in the borough, 50% of students are from these upper and middle classes, while the other 11 state schools have between 18-33% of students from these groups. Southwark’s upper and middle-class students are intensely concentrated in the borough’s private schools.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，在13所公立学校中，有两所学校50%的学生来自中上层阶级，而其他11所公立学校的学生来自中上层阶级的比例在18-33%之间。萨瑟克的中上层阶级学生集中在自治市的私立学校。

paragraphs.en: There’s a measure called the “index of dissimilarity” which can be used to work out how to achieve an even distribution of social classes across schools in Southwark. If you include private schools, 31% of students in the top two social classes and 28% of students in the lowest social classes would have to move school. But take private schools out of the equation, and just 2% of students in the most affluent groups and 6% of students in the poorest groups would need to move.
paragraphs.zh: 有一种被称为“差异指数”的方法，可以用来计算如何在萨瑟克的学校中实现社会阶层的均匀分布。如果你把私立学校包括在内，31%的前两个社会阶层的学生和28%的最低社会阶层的学生将不得不转学。但是把私立学校排除在外，只有2%的最富裕群体的学生和6%的最贫困群体的学生需要搬家。

paragraphs.en: In other words, Southwark has very low class segregation between its state schools. But this hides the fact that the upper middle and middle classes are overwhelmingly concentrated in private schools.
paragraphs.zh: 换句话说，萨瑟克的公立学校之间的阶级隔离程度很低，但这掩盖了中上层和中产阶级绝大多数集中在私立学校的事实。

paragraphs.en: This matters, because who we go to school with fundamentally shapes our experience of education and our outlook on life.
paragraphs.zh: 这很重要，因为我们和谁一起上学从根本上塑造了我们的教育经历和人生观。

paragraphs.en: These inequalities in intakes between private and state schools have been invisible until now.
paragraphs.zh: 私立学校和公立学校之间的入学不平等直到现在还没有被发现。

paragraphs.en: When students from deprived backgrounds are unevenly distributed between schools, attainment gaps – the difference in academic achievement between richer and poorer students – tend to be larger. The segregation of our schools by social class makes educational inequality worse. Less segregated, more socially mixed schools would improve achievement for all – and especially for lower-attaining students.
paragraphs.zh: 当贫困家庭的学生在不同学校之间分布不均时，成绩差距--富裕学生和贫困学生之间的学业成绩差距--往往会更大。我们学校的社会阶层隔离会加剧教育不平等。减少隔离、加强社会融合的学校会提高所有人的成绩--尤其是成绩较差的学生。

paragraphs.en: Grammar schools, which ostensibly select students by academic ability, are disproportionately middle class. Research has found that once their privileged intake is accounted for, grammar schools are “no better or worse than the other schools in England”
paragraphs.zh: 文法学校表面上是根据学术能力来选拔学生的，但实际上却不成比例地属于中产阶级。研究发现，一旦考虑到他们的特权招生，文法学校“并不比英格兰的其他学校更好或更差”

paragraphs.en: Class segregation between schools is quite simply unfair. This is why there was support for the abolition of selective schooling in the 1960s, when comprehensive schools were introduced in all but a few parts of England. Phasing out grammar schools was popular because the class inequalities in opportunity and attainment they caused was obvious.
paragraphs.zh: 学校之间的阶级隔离是非常不公平的，这就是为什么在20世纪60年代，人们支持废除选择性学校教育，当时英国除了少数地区外，所有地区都引入了综合学校。逐步淘汰文法学校是受欢迎的，因为它们造成的机会和成就方面的阶级不平等是显而易见的。

paragraphs.en: But this reform did not include private schools, a key driver of educational inequality.
paragraphs.zh: 但这一改革并不包括私立学校，而私立学校是教育不平等的一个关键驱动因素。

paragraphs.en: Concentrating advantage
paragraphs.zh: 集中优势

paragraphs.en: More than any other school type, private schools concentrate wealth and advantage. Private schools educate barely any working-class students. In my research with colleagues, less than 3% of students in UK private schools were from the lowest social classes, compared to 16.7% in state schools and colleges.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他学校类型相比，私立学校更集中于财富和优势。私立学校几乎没有教育任何工人阶级学生。在我和同事的研究中，英国私立学校的学生中只有不到3%来自社会最底层，而公立学校和大学的学生比例为16.7%。

paragraphs.en: We know that private schools are disproportionately attended by the highest earners and the upper middle classes. Yet we know almost nothing about how private schools affect the sorting and segregation of social classes between schools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们知道私立学校的学生大多是收入最高的人和中上阶层，但我们对私立学校如何影响学校之间社会阶层的分类和隔离几乎一无所知。

paragraphs.en: In our paper, we looked at the extent to which the social class composition of schools in local authority areas differs from the country as a whole. This allowed us to measure whether some areas had schools which were more segregated than others. Greater segregation meant that schools had more uneven distribution of working or middle class students relative to the national distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的论文中，我们研究了地方政府地区学校的社会阶层构成与全国整体的差异程度，这使我们能够衡量某些地区的学校是否比其他地区的学校更加种族隔离，更严重的种族隔离意味着学校中工人或中产阶级学生的分布相对于全国分布更加不均匀。

paragraphs.en: Divisions in cities
paragraphs.zh: 城市区划

paragraphs.en: Our research shows that the effect of private schools on increasing school segregation across Britain is substantial, but the effects are stronger in cities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究表明，私立学校对英国各地学校隔离的影响是巨大的，但在城市中影响更大。

paragraphs.en: London stood out. Even after removing private schools, it remained the most socially segregated region in England and more segregated than Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland too. Earlier research also suggests that social class divisions over access to sought-after state schools were particularly acute in the capital.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦的情况尤为突出。即使在取消私立学校之后，它仍然是英格兰社会隔离最严重的地区，比威尔士、苏格兰和北方爱尔兰的隔离程度还要严重。早期的研究还表明，在首都，在进入热门公立学校方面的社会阶层分歧尤其严重。

paragraphs.en: For post-16 education, London’s state schools and colleges are very unequal. In affluent western boroughs such as Richmond upon Thames or Kingston, working-class students are heavily concentrated in further education colleges, with a larger number of more middle-class state schools.
paragraphs.zh: 对于16岁以后的教育，伦敦的公立学校和学院非常不平等，在泰晤士河畔里士满或金斯顿等富裕的西部行政区，工薪阶层的学生大量集中在继续教育学院，更多的是中产阶级的公立学校。

paragraphs.en: In more working-class areas such as Enfield, middle-class students are concentrated in grammar schools, driving segregation up. Local context is key to understanding the specific drivers of class segregation in post-16 education in the capital. Whatever the circumstances, the capital’s state schools and colleges are highly unequal.
paragraphs.zh: 在恩菲尔德（Enfield）等工人阶级较多的地区，中产阶级学生集中在文法学校，这加剧了种族隔离。要理解伦敦16岁以上学生教育中的阶级隔离的具体驱动因素，当地背景是关键。无论情况如何，伦敦的公立学校和大学都存在高度不平等。

paragraphs.en: Outside London, private schools were drivers of class segregation in schools in other urban areas. Provincial cities and towns such as Wakefield or Hull in Yorkshire, Southampton in the south, Stockport in north-west England and Clackmannanshire in Scotland also saw very large falls in segregation when we excluded private schools from our analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在伦敦以外的地区，私立学校是其他城市地区学校阶级隔离的驱动力。当我们将私立学校排除在分析之外时，约克郡的韦克菲尔德或船体、南部的南安普顿、英格兰西北部的斯托克波特和苏格兰的克拉克曼南郡等省级城镇的种族隔离也大幅福尔斯。

paragraphs.en: In these areas the state schools and colleges have a more even distribution of social classes between schools and colleges; these private schools are particularly out of joint with their locality.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些地区，公立学校和学院的社会阶层在学校和学院之间的分布比较均匀;这些私立学校与当地的社会阶层特别不协调。

paragraphs.en: In the aftermath of the second world war, early supporters of comprehensive schools highlighted the democratic potential of schools to create a “common culture”. Rather than the deep class divisions the grammar school system created between academic and vocational education, councillors and teachers argued that comprehensives would be “the best education for democracy” and would create “a system which did not strengthen and deepen such distinctions”.
paragraphs.zh: 二战结束后，综合学校的早期支持者强调，学校具有创造“共同文化”的民主潜力。文法学校体系在学术教育和职业教育之间造成了深刻的阶级分化，但议员和教师们辩称，综合学校将是“最好的民主教育”，并将创造“一个不会加强和加深这种区别的体系”。

paragraphs.en: In the socially and politically divided times we live in, creating a democratic, common culture without class inequality ought to be on the agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们生活的社会和政治分裂的时代，创造一个没有阶级不平等的民主的共同文化应该被提上议程。

paragraphs.en: The social class inequalities between schools and colleges that we reveal in our study will not go away by doing nothing. A fully comprehensive system of education would be a democratic move towards a less segregated, more equal society for all.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在研究中揭示的学校和大学之间的社会阶级不平等不会通过什么都不做而消失。一个完全全面的教育体系将是朝着一个更少隔离、更平等的社会迈进的民主之举。
